what: Hand-written (source, candidate, meaning_changed) triples in the format of experiments/paraphrases/probes.json, kept in their own file so that the commit that adds them predates any reading of the validator. See README.md beside this file for how the set was written.

heldout_2026_11_02.status: DEV since 2026-11-02 - 94 probes (50 meaning changes, 44 faithful) written on 2026-11-02 by Claude (Anthropic model, claude-opus-5-5) acting as the agent that then fixes the validator, BEFORE it read guardrail/paraphraser.py, its tests, docs/DESIGN-paraphraser.md, any stored paraphrase or any earlier probe candidate, and committed (f366913) before the first measurement. Not independent of the fixer: same author, written knowing the validator would be fixed next. Held out for the heldout_2026_10_28 fixes (measured_after_heldout_2026_10_28_fixes); its own misses were then read and fixed by mechanism the same day, so its later figures are dev figures, not estimates.
